competences.description: Decreases the current HP of the enemy with the best HP status (Boss excluded) by 10%, and attacks the enemy target to inflict damage that's proportionate to the reduced HP.
Absorbs all other allies' HP by 10% to attack all enemies dealing damage that's proportionate to the absorbed HP. Recovers the Attack Bar of all allies by 20% afterwards.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Always perform an attack that has an attribute advantage on all enemies. Blocks all enemies (boss excluded) from removing harmful effects for 2 turns. Inflicts Continuous Damage that can't be resisted by the number proportional to the damage dealt for 2 turns.

effets.description: The skill always has an elemental advantage regardless of monster elements.

Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.
The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
The target under the Irresistible effect cannot resist any types of harmful effects.
